recent_notebooks.summary: Revised analysis integrating stoichiometric submatrix conditions, structural reaction network theory, and structural memory frameworks to distinguish true history-dependent states from transient persistence.
recent_notebooks.title: Hysteresis vs. Memory in Autocatalytic Reaction Networks

recent_notebooks.summary: Multistable autocatalytic reaction networks exhibit compositional memory, allowing stable states to be maintained across growth-division cycles. This memory is driven by the feedback between chemical kinetics and compartment growth, where stochastic transitions between states act as primitive mutations.
recent_notebooks.title: Compositional Heredity across Growth-Division Regimes

recent_notebooks.summary: Minimal copying fidelity is essential for open-ended evolution in prebiotic systems, though exact thresholds depend strongly on thermodynamic and network constraints.
recent_notebooks.title: Fidelity Thresholds for Prebiotic Evolution
